description: Replace the agent's business information and return the stored object. Known limitation: this is a FULL REPLACEMENT - fields you omit are cleared, so read mba_get_business_info first and send the existing values back with your change applied. Known limitation: business info is a CLOSED six-field schema - business_description, contact_info, delivery_and_shipping, payment_method, purchase_info, return_policy. Any other key is rejected. Knowledge that does not fit one of these six fields belongs in an FAQ (mba_create_faq), an agent skill (mba_create_agent_skill), a crawled website (mba_create_website) or an uploaded file (mba_upload_file) - not here.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_update_business_info
